name: claude-factory
description: claude-factory plus mirrored ponytail and caveman entries so they can be declared as same-marketplace dependencies.

plugins.name: claude-factory
plugins.description: PRD → epics → stories → implementation pipeline with a deterministic delivery workflow.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Mirrors DietrichGebert/ponytail so claude-factory can declare it as a same-marketplace dependency. Upstream: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail — 'write the least code' discipline, active by default (mode: full) once installed.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Mirrors JuliusBrussee/caveman so claude-factory can declare it as a same-marketplace dependency. Terse agent prose (fewer output tokens); code, commits, PRs and docs stay normal.
